title: GOV-0070: WP-IMP-0 — repair Work Package template/schema drift (prerequisite for badf-implementation-plan / G06)
problem:
## Observed

templates/work-package.json does NOT conform to schemas/work-package.schema.json (measured on main 78eab75): missing demand (required); data_classification "INTERNAL" (schema enum is lowercase public/internal/confidential/restricted); permissions is an object (schema type array); rollback {trigger,procedure,owner} (schema requires {reversible,method}). Plus ungoverned fields escalation/reviewers/non_functional_requirements. Nothing tests the template against the schema, so it drifted.

## Expected

**WP-IMP-0 -- repair the drift.** Rewrite templates/work-package.json to conform (add demand, lowercase internal, array permissions, {reversible,method} rollback; drop ungoverned decorative fields; minimal valid skeleton). Add tests/test_badf_work_package_template.py as a regression guard (template validates via check_schema + carries the four previously-wrong fields). NO schema change (the schema is correct; the template lagged). The new planning fields (dependencies/source_baselines/execution_budget/stop_conditions/...) are a BACKWARD-COMPATIBLE schema extension in WP-IMP-B, not here. Prerequisite for badf-implementation-plan (G06).

## Evidence

- Schema required set includes demand + data_classification(enum) + permissions(array) + rollback(reversible,method); template violates all four. Real WPs (WP-0082) already conform.

## Unknowns

None -- pure conformance repair + regression guard.
